title: Others made this pivot: the winners put products first
kicker: Six insurance software companies that started as services firms (public sources, Wayback snapshots)
notes: Source: data/pivot_case_studies.md. Adacta sold its ~300-person Dynamics services unit to BE-terna (2019); adacta.si now 301s to adacta-fintech.com; Gartner/Celent recognition and Volpi Capital investment (2021). Decerto: one domain with separate Products and Services menus; it still sells IT outsourcing / custom development alongside its insurance products (fact-check #15); satellite higson.io splits authority (no canonical). Majesco: demerged from Mastek 2014; 2016 nav mixed dev/testing services; today no Services in top nav; Gartner MQ Leader (2025), 375+ customers (Feb 2026, after the Vitech acquisition); acquired by Thoma Bravo ~$729M (2020). Exigen -> EIS: services spun off, product renamed. Stratoflow -> Openkoda: new product domain, services sister brand as implementation partner (works only for a brand-new product without search equity). Damco: InsureEdge still under a Services menu = where DICEUS is today.

cases.name: Adacta → AdInsure
cases.move: Sold services unit (2019), product company on new domain
cases.lesson: Full commitment; analyst recognition and investment followed

cases.name: Decerto
cases.move: Insurance products + software-house services, one domain
cases.lesson: Closest to DICEUS: separate Products and Services menus

cases.name: Mastek → Majesco
cases.move: Demerger (2014); services dropped from top nav
cases.lesson: Gartner MQ Leader, 375+ customers, acquired for ~$729M

cases.name: Exigen → EIS
cases.move: Services spun off, product brand renamed
cases.lesson: Clear product identity for buyers and analysts

cases.name: Stratoflow → Openkoda
cases.move: New product domain; dev shop kept as partner
cases.lesson: Works only for a new product with no search equity yet

cases.name: Damco → InsureEdge
cases.move: Product left inside a services site
cases.lesson: Warning: weakest product presence = DICEUS today

verdict_head: Recommended for DICEUS: Model A, one domain with products first (the Decerto / Majesco path)
verdict: Keep diceus.com: it already ranks #1 for captive and RRG software, and the Capterra, Gartner and Microsoft listings point there. A new domain would throw that away. Demote services in navigation now. Prune or merge them only when GSC and CRM show they earn nothing (a 'virtual spin-off', not a blind cut).
